playstyle: An unorthodox boxer built on counter hits and rushdown. His kick buttons are weaves and stance moves, not kicks. Duck and weave (LWV, RWV, DCK) under the opponent's attacks, catch their buttons with some of the best counter-hit tools in the game (Wavu), and stay compact so you are hard to whiff punish. He has no standard i15 launcher and a steep learning curve.

stances.name: Ducking Left (weave)
stances.note: LWV.1,2 is homing and +3 on block; it is also his combo ender.

stances.name: Ducking Right (weave)
stances.note: RWV.1,2 mirrors LWV.1,2: homing and +3 on block.

stances.name: Ducking
stances.note: DCK.1 is used in his launch combos; DCK.F+3_4 goes into EXD.

stances.name: Flicker
stances.entry: B after b+1 and other moves
stances.note: Flicker stance: FLK.u+2 tornadoes, FLK.1 appears in his combos.

stances.name: Lionheart
stances.entry: After moves like f+2,2 in combos
stances.note: LNH.1 is a Heat Engager; LNH.2 is his combo filler.
